title: Guard/coverage composition, certificate specialization, and liveness
claims_under_test: A guard compiled across independent graphs improves unseen candidate tails at equal dense support.
Separately addressable guard and coverage cells can recover selectivity economically.
A bounded certificate count can pass a frozen candidate-tail gate.
Exact typed evidence can expose genuine one-edit filename policy negatives.
A liveness bitmap removes deleted exact ordinals without rebuilding immutable similarity postings.

selection.layout: minimum tuning p95 candidate count, then false candidates, then hybrid payload
selection.certificate_count: first of 2,4,8 with full source recall and p95 candidates at most 8
